Title: Registered user signs in with email and password → lands on dashboard
Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter qa.user1@example.test and the fixture password
3. Click Sign in
Expected: Dashboard opens, header shows the user's name, no error toast

Title: Sign-in with a 7-character password is rejected before submit
Steps:
1. Open /signup
2. Enter a 7-character password
3. Move focus out of the field
Expected: Inline error "Use at least 8 characters" shown, Create account stays disabled

Title: Viewer cannot delete a project through the API
Preconditions: Token of a user with role Viewer, project P-1 exists
Steps: 1. Send DELETE /api/projects/P-1 with the Viewer token
Expected: HTTP 403, project P-1 still returned by GET /api/projects/P-1
